subject: ENGLISH
title: Plural Word Changers · M01 D08
introduction: Some nouns change in special ways and must be learned in context. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: More than one, like cats or boxes.
A word that names a person, place, or thing.
A group of letters with a meaning.
